summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting the purchase of 73 bitcoin for ~$63,646 each between June 8-14, 2026, updating its treasury holdings. It also provided a periodic update on cash, bitcoin holdings, STRC and SATA stock, and share counts. This is a routine operational disclosure of bitcoin acquisition and asset composition, not a special situation event. No board recommendation, deal terms, or structural changes were included. The filing reflects standard treasury management; there is no risk-arb angle.
